limits: Domain projection is pure-domain first-match evidence, not a live route.
Full-static host-only probes preserve earlier missing process, IP, DNS and core predicates as unknown.
Controlled suffixes use finite synthetic witnesses; no universal coverage is proved.
Shared host roles do not authorize routing all vendor tenants or URL paths.
Optional telemetry may be rejected. Pending roles never authorize exceptions.
No real account sign-in, API call, upload, application update or message was exercised.
scope: Claude登录、API、Files API上传、Desktop/Code更新与CDN、可选遥测的静态依赖台账；不执行真实账户或客户端流量。
